dedupe_keys.name: statistiques d utilisation data sncf com

description: Statistiques d'utilisation data.sncf.com is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données présente les indicateurs de fréquentation du site data.sncf.com, et d'utilisation des jeux de données. Ces données proviennent du Back office d'OpenDataSoft, de Google Analytics pour la période allant de février 2020 à mars 2021 et de PIWIK Analytics depuis juillet 2021. Mise à jour mensuelle. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marque et communication externe. Its keywords are Statistiques, Indicateurs Open Data. The portal shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
